jay_sec: Noticed recurring mTLS handshake errors in eu-central after the RBAC tighten on key-proxy last night. Root cause suspicion: new deny rule blocked KMS:Encrypt on the proxy's key alias. Need quick triage.

lina_kms: Can you paste a sample log? Prefer proxy and KMS request_id.

omar_sre: Sample: 
```
2025-04-03T21:04:12Z proxy WARN tls handshake failed: encrypt denied, err=KMSAccessDenied
request_id=aa11-bb22 region=eu-central instance=proxy-3
stack=proxy/tls/keystore.go:142
```
This lines up with policy change at 20:50 UTC.

jay_sec: The policy PR removed kms:Encrypt from the proxy role to reduce blast radius. We assumed only decrypt was needed for serving. Looks like encrypt is used for stuffing session tickets / key wrapping.

lina_kms: Correct: proxy uses Encrypt when wrapping ephemeral keys for session tickets. Without it, the proxy refuses to issue tickets -> full TLS resume failures. Two quick mitigations: add Encrypt back scoped to the specific key ARN + SourceVpc condition OR enable cross-region fallback to the keystore in us-west while we patch.

rita_prodsec: Cross-region fallback is risky because cipher suites and cert chains differ. If fallback is used, ensure fallback path validates certificate chain and sets ALPN correctly. Also ensure audit logs mark that fallback was used.

omar_sre: We can flip a scoped policy in <5m. Proposed snippet (narrow): 
```
# minimal allow for ephemerals
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:Encrypt"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:123456:key/proxy-ephemeral", "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalTag/role": "proxy"}} }
  ]
}
```
This grants Encrypt only to principals tagged 'proxy' for that key.

jay_sec: Also need audit capture: log every Encrypt/Decrypt attempt from the proxy for 48h with principal_arn, principal_tags, request_id, and peer_cert_sha256. Sampling=100% for eu-central.

lina_kms: I'll enable a dedicated audit sink and include the principal tags meta. But note: CloudAudit exports have ~1m lag. For fast detection, use proxy-side logs + heartbeat metrics.

omar_sre: Adding a short metric we can alert on: keystore.encrypt_error_rate > 0.005 over 5m. deploy-bot, can you wire that?

deploy-bot: alert-created: name=keystore.encrypt_error_rate; threshold=0.005; window=5m; notify=@eng-oncall,@eng-security; runbook=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/keystore-encrypt-failures

rita_prodsec: For incident play: if encrypt_error_rate > 0.5% or TLS resume failures cause >2% increase in p99 handshake latency, we abort RBAC change and roll back policy to previous state. Also open an incident and notify customers on dedicated plans.

jay_sec: Agreed. Also add a safety check to the rotator: do not drop kms:Encrypt until a canary probe confirms session ticket issuance.

lina_kms: I'll push the scoped policy and audit sink now. Will post ARN + sink id.

omar_sre: After patch, run quick end-to-end probe: 
```
# e2e probe
./mtls-probe --target internal.api.redwood --regions eu-central,us-west --check-resume --iterations 50
```
Collect results and paste summary here.

jay_sec: Extra note: vuln triage discovered helper lib that logs plaintext session keys in debug mode in rare error paths. Make sure debug=false in prod and rotate any keys that may have leaked.

lina_kms: We'll confirm no key material persisted in logs. If present, rotate affected keys and revoke any session tickets issued in the window.

omar_sre: Rollout plan: apply scoped Encrypt allow -> wait 2m -> run mtls-probe 50 iters -> if success rate >= 99% and no spike in encrypt_error_rate, consider RBAC change accepted. If failures, rollback.

jay_sec: Action items:
- lina_kms: apply scoped policy + create audit sink (AS-345) (in progress)
- omar_sre: run mtls-probe + monitor metrics (next 10m)
- rita_prodsec: prepare incident template & customer notify draft (if we hit rollback)
- jay_sec: update runbook with the Encrypt dependency and add preflight checks

lina_kms: posting policy diff and sink id: sink=secure-audit/AS-345; policy-pr=https://git.redwood/infra/policies/pull/482

omar_sre: probe summary: 50/50 iterations complete so far, resume success=96% (needs to hit 99%). Continuing.

jay_sec: keep thread updates. If we don't reach 99% in 15m, revert.

rita_prodsec: Also schedule a small postmortem to check why Encrypt was assumed unnecessary. Likely a gap in the deployment notes.

jay_sec: Thanks team.
